purpose: Add an additive canonical Backlog Item lane to live WF40. The lane detects exactly one GPT-Web backlog-item-v1 Markdown changed in a watched commit, fetches it using the existing opaque GitHub credential binding, delegates deterministic mapping/gating to the canonical repo helper, and invokes WF61 only when the separate non-secret runtime gate explicitly allows one provider call. Initial gate state is disabled, so applying this parent wiring causes zero WF61 executions and zero provider/model calls.

parameters.jsCode: const commit=$input.item.json??{};const stub=$('Code - Plan watcher repo gate stub').item.json??{};const files=Array.isArray(commit.files)?commit.files:[];const candidates=files.filter(f=>{const p=String(f?.filename||'');const s=String(f?.status||'');return /^docs\/runtime\/BACKLOG_[^/]+\.md$/.test(p)&&s!=='removed';});let classification='NO_CANONICAL_BACKLOG_IN_COMMIT';if(candidates.length===1)classification='CANONICAL_BACKLOG_DETECTED';else if(candidates.length>1)classification='MULTIPLE_BACKLOG_ITEMS_IN_COMMIT';return {json:{backlog_detected:candidates.length===1,classification,repo:String(stub.repo||''),commitSha:String(stub.currentSha||commit.sha||''),backlogPath:candidates.length===1?String(candidates[0].filename):null,candidateCount:candidates.length}};

const resp=$input.item.json??{};const det=$('Code - Detect canonical backlog item').item.json??{};const content=String(resp.content||'').replace(/\s+/g,'');if(!content)throw new Error('CANONICAL_BACKLOG_CONTENT_MISSING');const b64=s=>Buffer.from(String(s??''),'utf8').toString('base64');return {json:{repo_b64:b64(det.repo),commit_b64:b64(det.commitSha),path_b64:b64(det.backlogPath),markdown_b64:content}};
